book.name: Isáysa
book.title: Isáysarini kuku Nuw Isáysi yuwaa Apanll kamanirangu anoo kamanchintspa

content: Nuw Isáysi kurakaa Ajasa Apanllee kuk ichtakachuri kamanirangina

Síriyshuch kurak, Resín Israelshuchpat urkar tsiyatarangu, Zuwaa Pékaa, Irusarinshuchpat warateeni. Yamari kasiyeeruni, kasayani, tárangitaatssin, xapooranganaya. Anpur kurak Ajas Irusarinshuchee ksutarangiya. Ajas watacha Jotamarini wipa.

Síriyshuch urkar tsiyatssipanee tputs Ajasap zanganirangu, kusarangiya. Iy Síriyshuchini Efrayinchichpa amikurtaranguni, siyapa waratamaam zandkiniya, tárangiya. Ajassha anoo k'kuz mazinarangu, kapung punirangu, kizpur kambustaku yasin shpu shpu shitangat ashtaru, ashiru kizpur puniku, ta ta shitar ashirangiya. Sitatstee. ¿Tamachina? tárangiya.

Itaru, Apanllsha nuwaa tsiyatarangu, Isáysaa, shiy iparpatish, Sear-yasubpa ipuneerush, kurakap Ajasap napashincha. Ajas tsap kpimash kung tashtap taariya. Ngootsip yap chirikoo káchakana amb naangcha. Ajasaa anush chamayangayarush, nuwaa kuki kamaningcha.

content.text: Papcha, ichee, kurak Resínpa, min Pékpa amikurtarangitaatssin, anoo tputsi punirinllpa. Itaru, shiynaa kizpurtangcha.
Kurak Resín wamkurpat kurakpat Pékpa mangu nllur tamaparee ashirusin taakanaya.
Síriyshuch Efrayinshuchpat washunand shiyaa kiyung yachamaam zandkanaya.
Pza, Utaáchchish watsapun pshtuyaruni, tputsee tpuxtayaruni,
Sheeruni, Tabeelarineetsi wip kurakaam ínayani, táranganaya.
Pék yaktarini Samariycha, Efrayinash tsap taaritamta.

content: nuw siyaa atina. Ashirucha, Apanllee kuk zurampatari mazinangtsa, nuw atashina.
Nuw Ajaspa yusur tsiyataranguri, Emanowelaa kamanirangina
Apanllsha Taarashipani yusur tsiyatssee Ajasaam kamachtarangiya.
Shiysha, Ajasaa, Apanllee, Tsapush wantsush wizpurirish yámandanda, tángcha. Wandaya anoo nda zandkush, kanindash íwar yámandanda, tángcha, waa kuk zurampatari yasamaama, tárangina.
Ajassha, Nduni. Apanllee nguti mashcheezi, ndambari. Watsta, tárangiya.

content.text: Siy ngutis tputsee kuk ngataksa. Ngatkus, ¿mayaamsha
Itaru, siy nduntaa Apanllee Wizpurirish yámandanda, átus,
Mazinangtsa. Kiz kamasin mireeyaru, kamuz tatsipchiya.
Tatsipkachu, Emanowelaa yásamachiya, watam Apanll iyapa taakuwa,
Nllur ndaturi putsisaru, wand mangsharit taaku,
Itaru, ndaturi yutaritshishee kasaru, misha ndaturi
Itaru, Apanll shiyaatstam, tputsiriptartis, iparpatatamtis wanichiya.
Waneeshshee sirútama nduntaa ashiru nda patarus, waneeshimun kiyung kachiyatssa. Apanll
Efrayinshuchee, misha Síriyshucheetstam waneekchu, itaru siyaatsinaa ningattam wanichiya.
Apanll Ijiptomand arap tputsee kungumand aship yáyanll zanganchiya.
Patumbchish wach, misha kpashtam, misha kung wanasirimshishtam taachinllinaya.
Asiriyshuch kurak wachinpatari siyaa kiyung yachachinllinaya.

content: Shiyachich tputs kapung mariz kayatchinllinaya. Tputssha minamari wakar, opeejpatari tsimbunandari chinuku,
¿tamareeja mimir zapaneekchu, wayayaru, kesoa katungchis? Yuw tputs katuchim taaru, ¿antaati an keso kindurpat katungchazinllinaja? Watam iwariz kapung maringachuwa.
Mzarshis mangu kpanandari taachiya. Anush sirú mzarshis kizarunaa zapan milo yanungarangsa. ¿Kurik mbammash wanipaja mil taaranga? Itaru, natunaa karutanandarisha taachiya.
Kapanandarisha mzarshis yambutachiya. Anush pshtuyarush, k'chirpunguriptish napamaam waritariya.

Kizpur punikus, m'chitariptis ndusha puyamaam waritatssa, watam anush wakar opeejpatari mangu xitangat ashchinllinawa, nuw siyaa tina. Ashiriya, paptsa. Yuwash Emanowel kuskachu, anush siy kiyung kachiyatssa, nuw siyaa atina.

footnotes.text: Yuwaa nish átu anootstam Matiwa 1.23 kamankiya.
